statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote source rearms its MotionPlus hotplug probe timer at jiffies + HZ*4 after the detection attempt, and initializes/rearms polling only when built-in-MotionPlus and known-no-MotionPlus flags are absent. This is a four-second *host driver polling policy*, not a Wii Remote input-report cadence, activation latency or hardware response-time measurement.

applicability.revision: Linux host driver treating external versus integrated MotionPlus differently
applicability.scope: Consumer-side code at hid-wiimote-core.c lines 900-904, 910-934, 1176-1179 pinned via wii-linux-core; no device-side timing claim.
